Astella has no choice but to collect clues and find the iron-blooded Grand Duke, Leuber.
〔Astella’s heart rate is increasing! Be prepared for danger!〕
After running away from the ghosts chasing after her, she meets a young man at the end…
“Are you really Grand Duke Leuber Leonhard von Allen?”
In fact, this place is Leuber’s nightmare. Astella must help him regain his abilities to escape the game!
“What kind of crazy game is this!”
associated_names: Rescuing the Grand Duke from the Horror Game

73370.synopsis:
【Adorable, timid ghost uke X affectionate, wife-pampering, powerful exorcist seme】
How to successfully catch a timid and cute ghost?
Step One: Never draw the curtains of the room.
Step Two: Always stay alone in the corner.
Step Three: Accept all the gifts he brings.
Looking at the severed tail of a house lizard at his feet, Lian Yi picked it up without flinching, placing it in his room’s drawer. There were many such things — dilapidated toys, a bottle filled with some unknown viscous liquid, broken pens, a sparrow feather and so on…
Lian Yi closed the drawer and went to knock on the wardrobe door: “Are you there?”
A moment later, the door creaked open a crack from inside, revealing several slender, pale fingers, then a delicately beautiful face, shyly looking at him.
***
After spending some time with the human who had kept him, Nan Deng’s days had become more comfortable and nourishing.
This person, although always icy cold, neither laughing nor talking, treated the ghost Nan Deng quite well. He would protect him, indulge him, and feed him. Nan Deng liked him very much and wanted to always be with him.
Until later, Nan Deng accidentally discovered the real identity of this person was an exorcist.
A ruthless, cruel, slaying ghosts without blinking exorcist.
——The natural enemy of ghosts.
Nan Deng trembled in fear and fled in the night.
However, he wasn’t able to get far before he was found by Lian Yi.
Lian Yi was no longer pretending. With a gloomy countenance, surrounded by ruins filled with corpses and overwhelmed with menacing energy, his voice was soft and low, urging, “Nan Deng, come here.”
***
Lately, a piece of news had been circulating among the ghosts.
Yezhang Tower had suddenly collapsed, and the Ghost King imprisoned inside had escaped.
The ghosts cheered and were ecstatic, preparing to pay respects to the supposedly ruthless, fierce Ghost King.
“The Ghost King shall lead us to conquer the three realms!”
“Decapitate those damn exorcists!”
“Brothers, charge!”
However, when the ghosts, led by the grievous energy, finally found the fabled Ghost King, they saw him trembling behind the most powerful human and Chief Exorcist, Lian Yi, saying, “They’re so scary…”
associated_names: Catching a Rare Tiny Ghost is Prohibited

74906.synopsis:
Class A has a couple of top students, while Class F has a couple of underachievers. 
One weekend, they all stay together in a guest house.
The underachiever entered the wrong room and the top student ended up sleeping with the wrong person. Since then, the fates have reversed and intimate relationships have been misplaced… 
The male lead is a top student, the female lead is an underachiever in both the main and secondary couples, two couples in total.
This is a story with a happy ending, without moral or ethical considerations, purely for entertainment.

75162.synopsis:
The day our child died, my husband, Henderson, was not the least bit sad. The day after my child’s funeral, I saw him with another woman. She was… my child’s tutor, and the one who killed him.
***
I traveled back in time with the help of a shaman to save my child. When I opened my eyes again, I was back seven years ago. To the day after the night I had my child.
“Henderson. Forget what happened last night. You and I will never meet again.”
I left everything behind and left. I was just going to live quietly with my child…
“Honey, help me.”
The handsome maniac I had never seen before approached me, calling me honey.
Why was that?
“I want to be the father of your child.”
“…”
“You’re the only woman in my life.”
This man didn’t pull away from me as we discussed his heartfelt confession. Was it okay to love this man who seemed so familiar and suspicious?
And then there was Henderson, whom I thought I’d never see again.
“This kid… He looks a lot like me.”
Would I be able to protect my child from Henderson?
No, could I be happy with my child, who was the ultimate reason for my return to the past?

77466.synopsis:
Three months ago, Shen Chuo had a one-night stand in Las Vegas, got a marriage certificate on a whim, and then left the matter behind without a second thought. 
Three months later, Shen Chuo encountered his “husband” again at a signing ceremony for a school-enterprise cooperation. The man’s le*d gaze lingered on his butt, and he even whistled.
 Shen Chuo: “…” 
Now he regrets it, regrets it very much. – Pei Tingyue x Shen Chuo, a true scoundrel x Pretending to be decent, lawyer x professor, love after marriage

77978.synopsis:
Bai Ke’s first eighteen years were extraordinarily difficult – With his peculiar eyes, frightening birthmark… And a father who was usually abnormal, but became even more disturbed during thunderstorms.
He thought life couldn’t get any worse until he picked up someone. The tall man in black clothes, knelt down with a thud upon seeing him for the first time, with eyes so complicated that Bai Ke could hardly understand, and exclaimed, “Master!”
Bai Ke: “…First, put down the heads you’re holding in your right hand, and then we can talk about other matters.”
Author: This text contains various types of absurdity, enter at your own risk.
Bai Ke (Bai Lingchen) x Huo Junxiao (Yun Zheng)

78746.synopsis: Lynn has never had an easy life. A beautiful girl with pale silver hair resembling that of the Empire’s princess, she is sold to work in the Dukedom of Ereuputh. Elizabeth, the duke’s daughter, harbors jealousy towards the princess and takes pleasure in causing Lynn to suffer. Despite enduring in silence, Lynn’s life takes a turn when Martin, the young master of the dukedom, returns. He shows her kindness and she falls for him, knowing that it will only lead to heartbreak. Unable to resist, Lynn shares a passionate night with him, unaware that Martin is not the kind boy she used to know. For he’s had a taste of her, and he will never let her go…
associated_names: The Maid No Longer Desires her Master (Official Manhwa)

79002.synopsis:
The youngest Special Class in history, the Smiling Avenger, a walking calamity.

Father Ke: A-Wen, these are the company shares that Dad has set aside for you.
Mother Ke: A-Wen, this is the princess room that Mom has specially decorated for you.

81306.synopsis:
I was born as a martial artist of a collateral line of the Great Namgoong Clan and lived my entire life as such. The year I turned forty-five, the Demonic Cult ran rampant, and my life ended during the Great Orthodox-Demonic War.
However, when I opened my eyes, I had become the child of a strange Westerner?
“I heard you begged to be allowed to use the training grounds again this time.”
“Yes. I have now turned five, so if I do not start the sword now, it will be too late.”
“What do you intend to do by learning the sword?”
“I will try to become a Sword Master.”
“Sword, ahem. Right… So, my son wants to become a Sword Master.”
“It may seem like a distant path now, but by the time my body grows and my distancing fits, I think I will be able to show at least Sword Qi. Please grant me permission.”
“Distancing… Will you explain what that is, son?”
“It refers to the widening of the sword’s range where one can intercept the opponent as the limbs grow longer.”
“I see… If my son grows just a little more, he will be able to draw out Sword Qi easily….”
“Yes.”
A pine caterpillar eats pine needles, and a silkworm eats mulberry leaves. And a martial artist must hold a sword.
I determined that I would practice and learn the sword in my new world as well, to become a powerhouse of the Transformation Realm, a Grand Sword Master.
“It’s Professor Casablanca’s General World History class, right? I heard the class content is the same as last year.”
“Yes, that is correct, but….”
“I took notes diligently, use this.”
A handsome face, good lineage, and a gentle personality. A child who is flawless no matter where you look keeps following me around.
He takes care of class notes for me, rents study rooms for me, and even buys and offers me food. His ulterior motives are definitely suspicious. Is this a ploy to cajole me, the future Greatest Swordsman Under Heaven, into helping him become Emperor?
For that, isn’t he acting too…, …too, cute…?
The chaotic academy daily life and the story of a slowly soaking first love between a martial artist reincarnated in a Romance Fantasy world and a suspiciously gentle Imperial Prince!
associated_names: Namgung Se-Ga, the Warrior, Was Reincarnated in Romance

81818.synopsis:
Cha Euisung, formerly a destitute F-rank porter, had undergone regression and ascended to S-rank. After his tireless efforts, he finally secured the highest position within the Hunter Association! The moment he had been dreaming of finally arrived.
But then— BOOOM!
Suddenly, meteors showered from the heavens.
Cha Euisung: ”This doesn’t make any sense! No, no, no! Aaaagh!”
The world had been destroyed, and he found himself regressing once more! All his efforts had been for naught. Amidst his despair, a message suddenly flashed before his eyes.
System: [SAVE THE WORLD Protect the Earth!] 
Cha Euisung: “If I want to take advantage of the S-rank life to freeload, I have to…save the world?”
The second regression heralded the world’s destruction. Moreover, if he failed to stop the Demon King this time, this life would be his last. Ultimately, Cha Euisung, now a [Hero] , embarked on a quest to locate the [Demon King] . Standing before a decrepit schoolhouse in the tranquil village of Cheongse-ri, he encountered a towering man.
“……Is it really okay to hire someone like the Demon King as a teacher?”
Cha Euisung faced an unusual restriction: he must not harm the Demon King.
Will Cha Euisung able to save the world and retire in peace?

82330.synopsis:
Become the master of the world and bring about the revival of spiritual energy across the globe.
Use all beings as chess pieces to pave a path to immortality.

83354.synopsis:
The novel “What Happens When Villains Get Stronger” was the only joy in my repetitive daily life. One day, I woke up to find myself in the story as a “nameless assassin”.
“Who am I supposed to assassinate now?”
In a world ruled by villains, I find myself dragged to a place where my chances of survival are nearly zero from the start.

83610.synopsis:
A seemingly innocent but actually dark and obsessive younger disciple (top) vs. a mischievous, cool, and captivating senior disciple (bottom).
Xie Qinghan transmigrates into a failed BL novel as a minor cannon fodder character. The original character repeatedly harmed the protagonist, who eventually turned him into a cultivation furnace, using him until he was s**ked dry of his power and died miserably.
After transmigrating, Xie Qinghan only wants to complete his tasks and return home as soon as possible. On one hand, he bullies the protagonist, stealing his fortune and treasures, successfully making the protagonist hate him to the core. On the other hand, he secretly takes care of the protagonist, providing warmth and care with a different persona.
After completing his tasks, he dies in front of Wen Xueya and returns to the modern world. One day, the system alerts him: “The world is about to collapse, host! Go see the protagonist, QAQ!”
Xie Qinghan: ?!

83866.synopsis:
After traveling back in time to an ancient peasant family, the house was empty, her parents-in-law had passed away early, her husband had died, and she was left with four radishes to feed.
As the notorious and cruel stepmother who mistreated her children, Su Mulan didn’t have time to stare speechlessly at the sky. She calmly rolled up her sleeves, reclaimed wasteland for farming, set up stalls for business, and raised livestock…
The stepmother farms, raises children, deals with troublemakers, and works towards a prosperous and comfortable life.
This heartwarming story of farming and business involves daily activities of making money and raising children, leading a leisurely life. It includes food, child-rearing methods, struggles and challenges, achievements and laughter. The story mainly focuses on warmth, lightly touches on troublesome characters, and does not involve any system elements.

84378.synopsis:
One day, a 33-year-old man who spent all his time playing video games to escape reality from an unreasonable life of bullying and power harassment, died. 
However, he was chosen as a candidate for reincarnation to another world, but the woman who guided him to his reincarnation told him that she would not give him any cheats. Instead of cheats, he was offered three months of training at an otherworldly reincarnation training facility. 
The training facility was supposed to make it relatively easy to acquire skills, but what would he accomplish in three short months? He was given two bonus skills, Appraisal and Item Box, but he was thrown into the training facility before he could even begin to set up his prowess.
He spent three months in the training facility, desperately training to survive his new life. But after 3 months, after 1 year, after 10 years, he was not reincarnated. 
He was worried he might have gone to the infinite hell of the game world since he died from playing too much video games, but he still trained desperately. In fact, he never thought that the reincarnation process was not completed due to a mistake made by the female guide. After all, when 15 years of training had passed, the information about reincarnation came unexpectedly. 
The man who had already become a cheat bastard to the point of killing an ancient dragon was trying his best to enjoy the other world in a normal way.
associated_names: I Became the Strongest in Another World Through the Pre-reincarnation Tutorial. ~I Overprepared and My Second Life is in Easy Mode!~

86170.synopsis:
He Xiu Ying was an old lady. Every mealtime, she loved to call out, “Mimi, it’s time to eat.”
A group of my followers behind me asked, “Brother Biao, why does she call you Mimi?”
I was annoyed and said, “Whoever asks this question will die!”
Later, as she lay on the hospital bed, her wrinkled face turning ashen, she struggled to call me, “Mimi.”
My follower was puzzled, “Brother Biao, why does this old lady still call you Mimi?”
I raised my paw gently and said, “She was my grandma.”

88474.synopsis:
Li Fufeng, with a hospital city management game system in tow, finds herself transported to a post-apocalyptic world twisted by pollution and corruption. Everything has mutated, and the surviving people have grown te***cles and scales, resembling monsters more than monsters themselves. Life has become a living hell, with no hope in sight.
Thankfully, Li Fufeng has arrived.
The doctors in her hospital can remove the pollution, excise the mutated parts, and heal twisted bodies. They can even regrow missing limbs and, believe it or not, even lost heads!
But that’s not all. The hospital also has clean farms, ranches, and clothing stores, along with magical houses that upgrade and expand on their own. There’s even an insanely cool bike that can climb trees and dance!
All these are clean resources that are absolutely unheard of in this polluted world.
As the hospital continues to upgrade, connecting to the sea, laying pipelines for fresh water, and building an entertainment city, birds, beasts, flowers, and plants start to flourish again. More and more cities connect to the hospital, reclaiming polluted lands and bringing normalcy and hope to the patients.
Li Fufeng soon realizes that she has ended up saving this already dead world, becoming the eternal deity in the hearts of the survivors who were about to lose all hope.

88986.synopsis:
A pure-hearted rich second-generation student with poor grades VS An inters*x top student poor second-generation
You are Gu Siyi, a rich second-generation student with poor grades.
The pretty boy Lin Baiqiao sitting next to you is the top student in your class, a student tyrant poor second-generation student with heavy debts.
The two of you, who are very different in both family background and academic performance, should not have had much intersection, but the two of you have developed an impure relationship based on money because of a rescue system.
You became the other party’s sponsor and started a love story of making love while doing it.

89242.synopsis:
A driverless bus carried a group of cursed individuals to a mysterious black haunted house…
Inside the haunted house, there was a door stained with blood.
Every so often, those who were cursed would be forcibly pulled through the blood-red door into a terrifying world, where they had to complete horrifying tasks…
After experiencing one bizarre and chilling story after another within the haunted house, Ning Qiushui barely survived through countless near-death experiences—only to realize that everything was far different from what he had imagined…
The haunted house… wasn’t a curse at all, but rather…

90522.synopsis:
The quiet everyday life gets disrupted by a gal. No, it’s honestly a bother (but I’m happy).
I… Tooya Yukifumi, serve as the lone president of the Literature Club at my high school.
What kind of activities do we do, you ask? For example… reading the works of my beloved Kenji Miyazawa, or actively participating in activities… just kidding, I actually just stay in the room reading books all day (crying).
Into this peaceful Literature Club enters a gal from Tokyo, Shibusawa Mikane.
Why? How? She’s totally not that type of character, right?
From that day on, the Literature Club started running around Iwate chasing after the footsteps of Kenji Miyazawa, searching for “true happiness,” all caught up in her pace, and began to change.
Wait a second (happy)! Give me back my peaceful days (just kidding)!
Iwate × Literature × First Love = The start of a new youth novel!

91034.synopsis:
When I was young, I met Lee Jungin at the orphanage. We had the same name and birthday. The only difference was that he was the sole omega of a chaebol family. But after a car accident, I woke up in his body.
“Take this body. It’s yours, Choi Jungin.”
The moment Jungin saw this sentence on the very first line of a notebook he happened to find, his breath caught in his throat.
We had joked about it before. Lee Jungin envied my freedom since I had no family, while I envied him for being wealthy and having siblings.
But how…? How could this happen? He’s not a magician or a wizard; how can you just swap bodies at will?
“It’s dangerous, child.”
“Jungin, you need to be careful.”
“Hey kid, let me take you to your room. Wrap your arms around my neck.”
I’d heard that the alpha family considered Lee Jungin, born an omega, to be a disgrace, but his brothers’ behavior seemed a little strange.
And that wasn’t the only odd thing.
“Which bastard did this to you?”
“Uh…”
“I asked you, who messed with you, Lee Jungin?”
Lee Jungin even had a fiancé—an extremely dominant alpha who treated him surprisingly well.
“Jungin, tell me. Were all the things you said to me lies?”
 
* * *
“Hey… Beomhyeon.”
– Yeah?
“Want to play a game?”
With a self-deprecating smile, Jungin pressed the back of his hand against his hot eyes and asked:
“Even if I were ugly, poor, without a family… Even if I were a beta… would you still like me?”
– Yeah, I would have.”
With trembling lips, Jungin closed his eyes as Beomhyeon’s steady voice, full of certainty, continued:
– Don’t worry, Jungin. No matter what you look like or where you are, I’ll find you and love you more than anyone else in this world.
The conversation with Beomhyeon gradually eased his anxious heart.
– I love you, Jungin. I’ll take all your fears away, so you just keep smiling and be happy.
Listening to the gentle voice whispering like a dream in his ear, Jungin fell into a deep sleep. 
For a very long time, until a new dawn, his phone remained turned off.

91290.synopsis:
A max-level apocalypse expert transmigrates into a male Zerg and barely survives for 999 days on a barren star. Suddenly, a wife falls from the sky.
He Yi, now no longer single, looks at his freshly minted general wife and tears of joy slowly flow down, like rose petals scattered on fine white porcelain skin, wild and alluring.
“My name is He Yi. Please take care of me for the rest of my life.”
Thus begins his journey down the path of flirting with the general.
The male Zerg early education robot advises earnestly: [Master, lowly and savage female Zergs are not to be spoiled!] 
He Yi, captivated by beauty, spreads his hands: “My female Zerg, my rules!”
[Before the Marriage Physical Examination] 
He Yi whispers in a hoarse, tempting voice into the general’s ear: “Ah Zhao, does it feel good?”
The general, blushing furiously, turns his head to hide his eyes and mutters: “It feels wonderful.”
Faced with one conspiracy after another that disrupts his love life, He Yi, after being a lazy fish for too long, finally starts taking things seriously. He awakens as the only 3S-ranked royal Zerg in millennia.
When the royal Zerg is enraged, bodies pile up. Rivers of blood flow.
Later, under the gaze of millions, the young and handsome Emperor He Yi descends from his throne, extending his noble hand to his general:
“Ah Zhao, let’s enjoy this vast galaxy together.”
**
Zhao thought he would be alone for life until the day he met a dazzling male Zerg. He caught the sweet and intense scent of the male Zerg’s pheromones, a fragrance with deadly allure that made his heart skip a beat.
In a flash, he decided to win him over. To gain his favor and affection. To ensure his tender care lingered for him alone.
A seemingly cold but actually quirky little sunshine gong & a seemingly obedient but actually scheming, jealous shou.
Mainly gong pov, both are clean 1v1, with egg-laying.
A joyful and sweet story~

93850.synopsis:
Beasts of all kinds—spiritual beasts, demonic beasts, rare beasts, celestial beasts, ancient relics, dragons of fortune, sword spirits, corpse puppets, gu insects, mechanical marvels, and elemental spirits—every form and technique can be mastered.
The story begins in a third-rate cultivation sect, the Beast Taming Sect…
…
Struggle through the weak paths; ascend with the mastery of beasts!

94874.synopsis:
“Music, film, television, painting, calligraphy, sculpture, literature… Do you comprehend them all?”
“Just a bit,” I replied.

With a palette of talents at my fingertips, I set out to conquer the world through the diverse realms of art, aspiring to become the uncrowned king, admired by people from all walks of life.

95130.synopsis:
The world has plunged into the darkness of the apocalypse. In this grim reality, the entire world has become a brutal arena for evolution. It’s humanity’s greatest opportunity and trial, as well as a playground for gods and demons alike. 
Chen Bai is granted a second chance, going back in time to ten days before the apocalypse began. 
With a direct injection of the zombie virus, he awakens an SSS-level talent: Virus Sovereign! 
Now, he embarks on an extraordinary path of evolution, wielding control over the virus itself.

95642.synopsis:
Xia Che has liked Zhou Yige for seven years, and has been fighting against his love rival Pei Liao for seven years.
The two have a deep bond. They have the same s*xual orientation, liked the same person, and were competing for the top spot in the same school and for a job title in the same company.
It’s like he’s been cursed by same natural enemy that he can’t escape.
Xia Che endured it for seven years, but finally couldn’t bear it anymore. He angrily accepted the transfer and moved across half of the country with his luggage.
Haha, if he can’t afford to offend him, can’t he just hide away?
Xia Che, who escaped from Pei Liao, was full of hope for the future. He opened the door with the best mood.
“……the f*ck?”
On the sofa, Pei Liao, who was leisurely drinking tea, nodded friendly, “Director Xia, what a coincidence.”
Xia Che, “…Unfortunately, Deputy General Manager Pei, you are still haunting me.”
Yes, as long as the soul is not extinguished, the curse will not die.
If you committed sins in your previous life, you will have to pay for them in this life.
　　—
Xia Che felt that something was not right with his love rival– oh, now roommate.
Who would make breakfast for their love rival every day, pick him up from  work, and give him gifts on holidays?
That’s all fine.
Why… doesn’t this guy wear proper clothes at home?!
Xia Che couldn’t stand it anymore and slammed the table, “Will you die if you button your collar two more?!”
Pei Liao said casually, “Does my collarbone look good?”
Xia Che’s Adam’s apple rolled subconsciously, “Not bad?”
Pei Liao nodded and unbuttoned two more buttons.
Xia Che: “……???”
So later.
He woke up from his rival’s bed ?
　　——
A long time later, someone asked Zhou Yige about the most unforgettable experience in his life.
Zhou Yige: Thank you for the invitation. Does it count if my childhood sweetheart and the proud son of heaven are together?
associated_names: What to Do When Your Roommate Is Your Romantic Rival

97434.synopsis:
Sylvia was the eldest daughter of a ducal family, known for leading the effort to subjugate magical beasts for generations. However, the skill she was granted at the age of seven was ‘Accumulate Power After Defeating Magical Creatures’. Moreover, her magic attribute was the unknown ‘Livelihood’.
Her father, who had expected her to have strong offensive magic like his own, was furious. Her mother, the head of the family, deemed her ‘useless’ and ordered her to go to a ruined fortress at the edge of their territory. Sylvia set off with a wagon and a few livestock.

99482.synopsis:

99994.synopsis:
At 21, Hyunjae has a secret partner. It’s a relationship that’s hard to explain to others—because their meetings revolve solely around s*x.
The partner who indulges Hyunjae’s every desire in bed is Nanyeong. Though honest only between the sheets, this man hides much about himself. Yet, as their relationship continues, it feels like Nanyeong is starting to develop feelings for Hyunjae.

Why is that? Why won’t he say he wants to be my lover…?
“Hyunjae, we agreed not to get emotionally involved.”
When Hyunjae tentatively reveals his feelings, Nanyeong draws a line, treating their connection as nothing more than a s*xual arrangement. He even offers Hyunjae a large sum of money, as if to soothe the pain of rejection with cash—almost like buying off his heartbreak.
In the end, driven by his longing to be with Nanyeong, Hyunjae accepts the money.
What exactly are we to each other? Is my body really all you want?

101530.synopsis:
Hush is a thrilling crime novel filled with all-villain characters. The protagonist and supporting cast wreak havoc in a sinful city, committing heinous acts and leaving readers exclaiming, “What the hell!”
 In the end, everyone meets a miserable demise.
Shen Yan transmigrates into the story.
And becomes the protagonist’s neighbor.
The protagonist, the leader of a crime syndicate, is a god-tier maniac who single-handedly builds a team of villains, leads them in chaos, and, out of sheer boredom, orchestrates their collective downfall.
 A dark twist on the “overpowered protagonist” trope.
The neighbor, Shen Yan, is the protagonist’s first henchman, a fervent admirer who, under the protagonist’s influence, practically offers up his heart as a token of love.
Shen Yan (closing his eyes): “Not bad. A heart-and-soul kind of brother.”
 With no money to move, he has no choice but to adapt in order to survive.
As the saying goes, birds of a feather flock together. Shen Yan decides to emulate the protagonist’s persona to stay alive.
 Are you a lunatic? Me too!
 Do you hate idiots? Me too!
 Do you want to destroy the world? Haha, surprise, me too!
Successfully pretending to be a maniac, he becomes the protagonist’s closest friend.
The protagonist brands a kiss on his hand, interlocking their fingers, his eyes deep and brimming with an unnerving fervor.
 “You’re the only one worthy to stand by my side.”
Later, Shen Yan saves up enough money and decisively flees. To ensure no loose ends, he betrays the lunatics and gets them locked up in Star Prison for ten thousand years.
Then he fakes his death, assumes a new identity, and sneaks off to a remote planet.
After two carefree years, he sees a news broadcast where the host calmly reports an update on the Star Prison:
 “On July 28th, Star Year 136, a crime syndicate led by a certain Ruan has successfully broken out of Star Prison. Citizens are advised to…”
The host’s mouth keeps moving, but Shen Yan hears nothing.
The protagonist hugs him from behind, resting his chin on his shoulder.
 The red-haired fugitive points at Shen Yan’s wanted poster on TV and laughs loudly.
 The fragile scam artist hides under the dining table, clutching Shen Yan’s ankle, trembling.
 The cold arsonist pulls out a chair to sit across from him, lights the tablecloth on fire, and smiles at him through the flames.
“Baby,” the protagonist murmurs, kissing Shen Yan’s temple.
 “This time, how are you planning to run?”
Shen Yan (surprisingly calm): “Haha, what a lively reunion!”

101786.synopsis:
A childhood friend of mine is a beautiful girl who has been cheeky lately.
She has found a su*cide note that I wrote (for fun) a long time ago……
associated_names: Namaiki na Osananajimi ni Mukashi Asobi de Kaita Isho wo Misukerareta Kekka, Kyuu ni Shiorashiku Natte Hanarenaku Natta
生意気な幼馴染に昔遊びで書いた遺書を見つけられた結果、急にしおらしくなって離れなくなった

103322.synopsis:
Tang Mo transmigrated into an exhilarating cultivation novel. Upon learning the plot, he refused to continue being a cannon fodder lapdog and tool for others. 
Resolutely, he left the sect, determined to establish his own path and live a good life.
However, on his way down the mountain, compassion stirred in his heart, and he picked up a pitiful, dying girl. Unexpectedly, this act of kindness brought him back none other than the villainous boss—the Demon Empress—who, in the years to come, would love him to the depths of her soul!
The Demon Empress: “Everyone deceived and harmed me, but you alone treated me sincerely. Since you were the one who barged into my desolate fate, healed my body, soothed my heart, and redeemed me, you will never have the chance to leave again…”
As time passed, his life only grew better. He transformed into a legendary master of alchemy and medicine, astonishing the three realms. With pills in one hand and medical skills in the other, his spiritual eyes could pierce through destiny itself. Immortal sects vied to win his favor, and great cultivators flocked to him without end.
The Grandmaster of Alchemy praised him, saying: “One pill can unlock the Dao of the Three Realms, and one medicine can reverse the gates of life and death.”
Meanwhile, his former junior and senior sisters, now wracked with regret, wept until their hearts nearly shattered, begging for forgiveness.
Tang Mo merely cast them a cold glance and said indifferently: “Sincerity is as worthless as dirt. A broken mirror cannot be made whole again.”
But in his heart, he scoffed: Weren’t you all supposed to follow the original plot and cling desperately to the protagonist? And now, you’re here wallowing in regret over me? Ridiculous.
associated_names: 開局脫離宗門，她們追悔莫及

103834.synopsis:
An open-world shooting RPG, Neo Haven, where no matter how many times you repeat the episodes, you can never achieve the all clear ending.
Just when I thought I had finally cleared the hidden true ending… this time I have to beat it for real, without any assistance from the game system or save/load options.
associated_names: 사이버펑크 게임 속 서브 히로인이 되었다

106138.synopsis:
“Please, ease your anger and look here, my lord. I-I believe I would be a suitable partner for the young master’s night lessons.”
Fleeing from the orphanage director who had tried to sell him off, Eti ran through the streets until he was almost hit by a carriage. He was saved by a benevolent duke and decided to pledge his loyalty as his servant.
Years later, now an adult, Eti discovered that the young master needed a partner for his s*xual education. However, the young master suffered from mysophobia and was particularly sensitive and irritable when it came to women, making it difficult to find a suitable partner.
Concerned about the duke’s heirs, Eti secretly went to visit the Duke. Presenting himself as the one capable of fulfilling the role, he then revealed his secret.
“Again.”
“Pardon?”
“—Again, show it to me.”

109978.synopsis:
“Is it you? The modern-day Sim Cheong selling his ass to pay off his father’s gambling debt.”
Seo Yuwon, forced into prostitution because of his gambling-addicted father, is one day dragged into the infamous gang known as San, where he is made to sell his body.
“While the wife’s out there working her ass off, and our beloved gigolo’s just sittin’ back munching on melons. What a f*cking charmed life, huh?”
The man begins to fall deeper and deeper for Seo Yuwon, eventually treating him as an exception to all his usual rules—but after Seo Yuwon tries to escape, everything changes.

110746.synopsis:
Chen Feng, once recognized as an invincible war god after retiring from the special forces, returns to his home village only to discover he now has a one-year-old daughter. And her mother turns out to be the beautiful CEO of a multinational corporation! 
So, since someone is out there making money to support the family, isn’t it only natural for me to become a stay-at-home dad and take care of our daughter?
“Daddy, daddy, get up~ My dough soup is ready~”
“Daddy, that person is a bad guy! She’s blocking our front door—I’m going to teach her a lesson!”
“Daddy, why do some people say you’re living off a woman? Hmph! They don’t know a thing—being a stay-at-home dad is the best!”
Holding little Linglong in his arms, Chen Feng raised his eyebrows and grinned, “They’re just jealous!”
associated_names: 退伍后，回到山村当奶爸

111258.synopsis: By a strange twist of fate, university student Keisuke Yoshida encounters a girl who has lost her memory… and thus, Keisuke sets out to search for her memories.

112026.synopsis:
As the saying goes, lying flat is temporarily satisfying, lying flat all the time is always satisfying.
Jian Wu, as one of the victims of China’s ultra-intense exam-oriented education system, resolutely joined the ranks of the “lying flat” movement after failing the postgraduate entrance exam once again, choosing to fish (slack off), raise flowers (wait for death) at home.
Then he broke up with his childhood sweetheart boyfriend of seven years.
Diametrically opposed to Jian Wu, Song Shuci is a veritable “involution king”.
And he’s the kind of king of involution who feels that doing anything other than studying and working is a waste of time.
After the breakup, Jian Wu silently left their small home, along with the city that held several years of their love, carrying his tortoise.
Until one day, he saw Song Shuci again, through the glass panel of the school conference room.
The man was tall and elegant, his image as an elite intellectual hadn’t changed a bit.
The usually aloof dean was inviting Song Shuci to join with all sorts of jaw-droppingly generous conditions, while the latter’s expression remained indifferent, clearly uninterested.
But when Jian Wu turned his head away, he heard him say: “I am willing to join your school.”*
B Medical University is located in a remote area, and its teaching staff has always been quite average. Successfully recruiting a heavyweight scientific researcher like Song Shuci undoubtedly stirred up a heated discussion within the school.
Colleague A: “The new Professor Song looks so handsome in a white coat!” Jian Wu, expressionless: “It’s been stained with mouse shit.”
Colleague B: “Professor Song is so efficient, he’s down-to-earth, and replies to messages so quickly.” Jian Wu sneered: “Indeed fast, he sends messages even faster when he’s cursing someone out.”
Colleague C: “I heard Professor Song is still single, whoever dates him will be so lucky.” Jian Wu rolled his eyes: “Whoever wants this luck is an idiot.”
****
Half a year later, Jian Wu and Song Shuci posted a photo on their WeChat Moments, holding hands and wearing rings.
Colleagues: “???”
Jian Wu replied: “I’m an idiot.”
Song Shuci snatched his phone away and hugged him from behind: “I heard you’ve been telling everyone I’m fast?”

114074.synopsis:
In a world where witchcraft has been wiped out by witch hunts,
I have become the only remaining strongest witch on Earth.

119194.synopsis:
Once the diligent servant of the Elven race, Bai Qi is betrayed by his fiancée, the Elven Princess, on their wedding night.
A cheat ability arrives late. 
As if by a twist of fate, Bai Qi finds himself becoming the leader of the Night Elves. 
The truth that has been sealed for a thousand years on the Lulucia Continent is about to be unveiled:
Is magical civilization an invasion? Is the civilization Bai Qi brings with him also an invasion—or perhaps they’re both invaders, or something even more?
Within the mists there are yet deeper mists.
The sun may set, but the night shall never end~
The Eternal Night Empire!
Monsters, once wantonly slaughtered?
“From now on, slimes are the mascots of the Eternal Night Empire!”
s*aves, trampled at will?
“Wherever the Empire of Eternal Night shines, all are equal—every race, every person!”
Why?
The Industry of Eternal Night: Elven firearms, steel behemoths, rulers of the sea, kings of the sky, orbital star annihilators…
“From this moment on, I will never allow anyone to raise their voice at me again.”
associated_names: 新婚之夜，遭受精灵公主背叛

119706.synopsis:
“Yoonjo.”
“Yes… Yes, CEO Sahyeok.”
“Spit it out so I can understand just what I’m supposed to be worried about because of a who*e like you.”
At the man’s threatening question, Yoonjo quickly opened his mouth.
“P-Pregnancy.”
Swallowing hard under the fierce gaze fixed upon him, Yoonjo forced the words out.
“They said pregnancy… would be impossible. That it’s physiologically absurd… Besides, you like it raw.”
As Sahyeok closed the distance, the pale skin of Yoonjo’s nape was exposed below his tilted chin.
“For a pathetic Omega who only presented after turning twenty-five.”
“I’m sorr— hic… I’m sorry… hiccup, sob, I’m, I’m sorr—”
“Insolent.”
Sahyeok looked down at Yoonjo’s cheeks, which had grown gaunt over the past six months, the healthy baby fat all but gone. He whispered,
“Yoonjo.”
“Ahk… Yes… sob, yes, C…EO…”
“Let’s find out. Let’s see what comes first: you spitting out a brat, or your body breaking down.”

128154.synopsis: The destined fight that came to Sangjun, who was a pathetic weakling.

166810.synopsis:
When she opened her eyes, it was ‘a strange ceiling’.
Up to this point, it wasn’t bad.
True to a ‘romance fantasy’ setting, there were no hygiene issues, and she remembered most of the original story.
Anne Agnes. Her role wasn’t bad either.
She was the villainess, but her misdeeds amounted to nothing more than small acts of interference born of jealousy.
With her looks and her family background, there was nothing lacking, so she only had to follow the original moderately and then find her own life.
There was just one problem.
Why did it have to start from when she was five?
“Evil spirit! Begone from Agnes’s body at once!”
She had suddenly turned into a tiny child whose fine motor skills weren’t even fully developed!
As if something had been connected wrong, her arms and legs absolutely wouldn’t move the way she wanted.
Crawling on all fours while flipped over.
Climbing up walls.
Hanging from the chandelier on the ceiling.
Smelling flowers, then chewing and swallowing them.
During meals, plunging her nose into a glass of water and nearly suffocating.
Anne committed all kinds of bizarre antics.
In the end, she even attacked the male lead’s… family jewels.
The prince woke up after an emergency surgery.
Logan spoke with a shocked expression.
“What do you mean? I’m im… impo……”
No! It can’t be!
I’m sorry, but do I still maybe have a shot at a third life…?
associated_names: Don’t You Dare Break the Original Story
